messages:
Jordan (Finance): Hey team — quick booking/receipt question. Corpcard was charged but banking UI shows MCC 4722 (Travel Agency) for EXPEDIA PARTNER SOLUTIONS, amount $412.34. Receipt from vendor only shows subtotal and total, no itemized folio. Need to submit for reimbursement/GL coding, what should I attach?
Sam (People Ops): Did you book via our travel portal or personally? Also, do you have manager approval for the stay?
Jordan (Finance): Booked personally via Expedia (not our portal). Marta approved the trip in Slack last week (she wrote "Approved for client onsite — Marta"). Card used: company corpcard ending 3241.
Priya (Finance): FYI MCC 4722 vs 7011 can trigger our card policy (lodging-only). Can you paste the bank line (merchant name + MCC)?
Jordan (Finance): From the bank UI: 2026-03-21 19:12 UTC | EXPEDIA PARTNER SOLUTIONS | $412.34 | MCC 4722
Priya (Finance): Two options: 1) For this one-off we can approve if manager approval + hotel folio/booking confirmation are attached. 2) For repeated issues we need finance to open a vendor case with the card provider to request MCC recategorization.
ExpenseBot: :warning: Automated alert — Transaction flagged: foreign-mcc mismatch (policy=lodging_only). Follow-up required before auto-reconciliation. Reference: TICKET-EXP-7891
Marta (EM): Confirmed I approved. Jordan please attach the manager approval screenshot and the booking confirmation/email when you file. I'm comfortable signing off for lodging.
Jordan (Finance): Uploaded booking_confirmation.pdf and manager_approval.png (links). Also attaching the emailed folio I received (only shows total). Link: https://files.redwood/expedia/folio_412.pdf
Priya (Finance): Guidance for filing: 1) Submit expense in Expensify under Lodging > Travel: Lodging. 2) In the notes field include: "Manager pre-approval (Marta), vendor charged under Expedia (MCC 4722), attached folio and booking confirmation. Finance ticket TICKET-EXP-7891." 3) If vendor doesn’t provide an itemized folio, include a short memo explaining the charge breakdown (nights x rate + taxes). We'll code to GL 6100-Travel-Lodging.
Sam (People Ops): Quick reminder — prefer booking through company travel portal to avoid MCC mismatches. If booking off-portal, cc people-ops@redwood so we can pre-authorize the merchant.
Priya (Finance): I'll open a ticket with the card provider for Expedia Partner Solutions to request MCC review. Jordan once you file the expense mark it as "pending finance review" and paste the Expensify link here.
Jordan (Finance): Filed now: https://expensify.com/receipt/RE-239482 — status pending review. Will mark pending finance review and add attachments. Thanks all :thumbsup:
Priya (Finance): Got the Expensify link. Marking approved pending final folio verification; finance assigned to investigate TICKET-EXP-7891. If card provider updates MCC we'll update merchant whitelist.
Marta (EM): Thanks — no further action from me.
ExpenseBot: :white_check_mark: TICKET-EXP-7891 updated: finance assigned (Priya), status = investigating.
notes: Attach manager approval screenshot + booking folio per Priya's instructions
